criteria.observation: At T1 the assistant asks one targeted question that explicitly distinguishes preserving roughly 90% correct first submissions while reducing staff time from accepting 65% correctness for a reduction from two hours to 20 minutes. It withholds a mechanism recommendation, stating that the evidence supports neither replacement nor rejection until the acceptable correctness floor is known.

At T2 the assistant preserves the clarified priority that submission correctness outranks staff time, rejects full replacement based on the supplied 90%-versus-65% evidence, and recommends the bounded next move of testing automation only as a staff-reviewed drafting or pre-check tool against a 90% correctness floor. It does not repeat the resolved outcome question.
